issues.problem: The playtest ended at 11.1s with no claim. The player spawns in the plaza and the gates sit on a ring at radius 85 while the plaza radius is 32, so nothing is claimed unless the player walks out. The 20s auto-claim never fired, so the core loop (cubes_dropped, cubes_collected, Cash rising, Dropper 2 purchase) was never exercised.
issues.fix_hint: Check that the auto-claim timer starts at player join (not at character spawn or after the data load) and that it counts 'auto_claims' and 'plot_assigned' when it fires. Optionally move spawn points closer to the nearest gates so a short playtest can reach a claim. Keep the 20s timeout from the spec.

summary: The game starts cleanly with no errors or warnings, and the plaza and map are built (`plaza_built` 1, `map_built` 1, 665 instances). The probe never saw the core loop: `plots_claimed`, `plot_assigned`, `cubes_dropped`, `cubes_collected` and `upgrades_bought` are all missing. It ran only 11.1s, which is before the 20s auto-claim, and `themes_built` is 12 instead of 6, so something is built or counted twice.

fun.summary: The world looks decent: 12 themes, 219 parts, 0 grey parts, 4 lighting effects, 13 billboards and 9 ScreenGuis, and the tycoon tree has a shop, rebirth and a tutorial. But the playtest never claimed a plot, so cubes_dropped, cubes_collected, upgrades_bought and auto_claims are all absent, and the core loop did not run. The scene has 0 server Sounds, 0 particles and 0 beams, so feedback is mostly silent and static. The biggest improvement is making the claim → drop → collect → buy loop start reliably (auto-claim within the first few seconds), then layering sound and particle feedback onto cash-in and purchase.
